# Temple Scroll Column 23 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 23 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**23:1** On this altar you shall present your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, your tithes and freewill gifts, and every special offering you have vowed to Me.

**23:2** There you shall eat in My presence with celebration — you with your families, your sons and daughters, your servants, and the Levite living in your community, since he has received no land inheritance among you.

**23:3** Be careful not to offer your burnt offerings at just any place you see. Only at the site I choose within one of your tribes may you bring your burnt offerings.

**23:4** There you shall carry out everything I command: your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and freewill gifts, and the finest of the vows you make to Me.

**23:5** Never offer unauthorized incense on it, nor any unapproved burnt offering or grain offering; do not pour any improper drink offering on it.

**23:6** Present your fellowship offerings there, and eat and celebrate before Me at your appointed festivals.

**23:7** Each day, offer on the altar the regular burnt offering: one unblemished year-old lamb in the morning, and the second lamb in the late afternoon.

**23:8** With each lamb, offer a tenth-measure of fine flour mixed with a quarter-hin of pressed oil, and a quarter-hin of wine as a drink offering — a fire-offering producing an aroma that pleases Me, the LORD.

**23:9** On the Sabbath, offer two unblemished year-old lambs with two tenth-measures of fine flour mixed with oil for the grain offering, plus the accompanying drink offering.

**23:10** This is the Sabbath burnt offering for every Sabbath, offered alongside the regular daily offering and its drink offering.

**23:11** Once each year, make atonement on the altar's horns using the blood of the sin offering of atonement. This annual atonement rite shall be performed on it.

**23:12** Throughout all your generations, it remains supremely sacred to Me, the LORD.

**23:13** At the start of each month, bring Me a burnt offering: two young bulls, one ram, and seven unblemished year-old lambs.

**23:14** Present three tenth-measures of oil-mixed fine flour as a grain offering with each bull, and two tenth-measures of oil-mixed fine flour with the ram.

**23:15** With each lamb, offer a tenth-measure of oil-mixed fine flour — a burnt offering, a fire-offering, an aroma pleasing to Me, the LORD.

**23:16** The drink offerings: half a hin of wine per bull, a third of a hin per ram, and a quarter-hin per lamb. This is the monthly burnt offering to be presented at each new moon throughout the year.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 23 well preserved. "Peace offerings" rendered as "fellowship offerings" to convey the communal meal aspect. "Between the evenings" rendered "late afternoon" for clarity. The sacrificial calendar follows Numbers 28-29 closely but in the Temple Scroll's characteristic divine first person.*
